biological.citation: Somatic RAP1B gain-of-function variant underlies isolated thrombocytopenia and immunodeficiency. (PMID: 39225097)
biological.summary: RAP1B acts as a molecular switch regulating cell signaling, cytoskeletal remodeling, cell trafficking, and integrin activation in platelets and lymphocytes. Gain-of-function variants G12E, G12V, and G60R increased RAP1B activation, talin recruitment, and integrin activation, modifying platelet activation, T cell proliferation, and migration. A somatic heterozygous de novo G12E variant caused neonatal thrombocytopenia, combined immunodeficiency, neutropenia, and monocytopenia, fully reversed by allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation.

biological.citation: Dapagliflozin activates the RAP1B/NRF2/GPX4 signaling and promotes mitochondrial biogenesis to alleviate vascular endothelial ferroptosis. (PMID: 40280228)
biological.summary: RAP1B upregulates NRF2 and promotes its nuclear translocation, activating the xCT/GPX4 signaling pathway to inhibit lipid peroxidation and ferroptosis in vascular endothelial cells. Dapagliflozin upregulates RAP1B (identified by RNA sequencing), and RAP1B also mediates mitochondrial biogenesis and oxidative phosphorylation. In vivo, Apoe-/-;Rap1b-/- double-knockout mice showed that Rap1b knockout blocked dapagliflozin's inhibitory effects on atherosclerotic plaque formation and ferroptosis.
biological.sample_size: HUVECs in vitro; Apoe-/-;Rap1b-/- mouse model

biological.citation: Hepatocyte-specific RAP1B deficiency ameliorates high-fat diet-induced obesity and liver inflammation in mice. (PMID: 40083059)
biological.summary: Liver-specific RAP1B knockout (LKO) mice on a high-fat diet showed reduced body weight, fat mass, hepatic lipid accumulation, macrophage infiltration, and oxidative stress, with downregulation of MAPK(p38) and NF-κB signaling. Conversely, RAP1B overexpression (OE) mice showed increased liver weight, aggravated lipid accumulation, worsened insulin resistance, and elevated inflammation. RAP1B-knockdown AML12 hepatocytes were used for in vitro validation, and transcriptome/metabolome analyses identified key metabolic shifts.
biological.sample_size: LKO and OE mice fed HFD for 18 weeks; RAP1B-knockdown AML12 cells

biological.citation: Targeting Rap1b signaling cascades with CDNF: Mitigating platelet activation, plasma oxylipins and reperfusion injury in stroke. (PMID: 39256999)
biological.summary: CDNF (cerebral dopamine neurotrophic factor) acts as an endogenous antagonist that interferes with GTP binding to Rap1b, reducing Rap1b activation and downregulating the Rap1b-MAPK-PLA2 signaling pathway, which decreases thromboxane A2 release and platelet aggregation. Subcutaneous CDNF administration in a rat ischemic stroke model significantly reduced platelet activation, aggregation, lipid mediator production, infarct volume, and neurological deficits. Studies used platelets from hemorrhagic stroke patients and animal models.
biological.sample_size: Rat ischemic stroke model; hemorrhagic stroke patient platelets

biological.citation: Host Cell Rap1b mediates cAMP-dependent invasion by Trypanosoma cruzi. (PMID: 36897926)
biological.summary: Pull-down experiments detecting active Rap1b-GTP and infection assays using cells transfected with constitutively active Rap1b-G12V demonstrated that Rap1b mediates cAMP/Epac-dependent host cell invasion by Trypanosoma cruzi. Fluorescence microscopy showed relocalization of Rap1b to the parasite entry site during infection. PKA-dependent phosphorylation of Rap1b had an antagonistic effect on invasion, and MEK/ERK signaling was identified downstream of cAMP/Epac/Rap1b.

biological.citation: Myeloperoxidase-anchored ENO1 mediates neutrophil extracellular trap DNA to enhance Treg differentiation via IFITM2 during sepsis. (PMID: 40892462)
biological.summary: IFITM2 acts as a DNA receptor that senses NET-DNA and activates intracellular RAP1B and its downstream ERK signaling pathway to promote Treg differentiation and function in CD4+ T cells during sepsis. ENO1 inhibition significantly attenuated NET-induced Treg differentiation and alleviated sepsis in mice. The IFITM2-RAP1B-ERK axis was identified as a key regulatory mechanism for sepsis-induced immunosuppression.
biological.sample_size: Mouse sepsis model; CD4+ T cell experiments

biological.citation: Fibronectin 1 Aggravates Colon Cancer Metastasis by Regulating RAP1B Protein Stability Through Akt/CREB Signalling Pathway. (PMID: 40638546)
biological.summary: FN1 interacts with RAP1B and suppresses the interaction between RAP1B and the E3 ligase PARK2, relieving RAP1B ubiquitination and improving RAP1B protein stability. FN1-RAP1B activates the Akt signaling pathway, leading to CREB phosphorylation and activation, which in turn transcriptionally upregulates FN1 and TIMP1, forming a positive feedback loop promoting colon cancer metastasis. FN1 promoted liver and lung metastasis of colon cancer in nude mice through RAP1B.
biological.sample_size: In vitro colon cancer cell lines; nude mouse xenograft model

biological.citation: A novel DCSTAMP antagonist impedes preosteoclast fusion via modulation of RAP1B-RAC1-mediated cytoskeletal remodeling. (PMID: 41423555)
biological.summary: A previously uncharacterized DCSTAMP signaling cascade involving direct DCSTAMP-RAP1B interaction was identified, which activates RAP1-RAC1 signaling-dependent cytoskeletal reorganization during osteoclastogenesis. A novel small molecule E8431 inhibits the DCSTAMP-RAP1B molecular interface, impeding preosteoclast fusion and bone resorption. E8431 administration attenuated ovariectomy-induced bone loss in murine models.
biological.sample_size: In vitro osteoclast cultures; ovariectomy mouse model

biological.citation: ICP4-Associated Activation of Rap1b Facilitates Herpes Simplex Virus Type I (HSV-1) Infection in Human Corneal Epithelial Cells. (PMID: 37515145)
biological.summary: HSV-1 immediate early gene ICP4 inhibits PKA phosphorylation to induce Rap1b activation, which promotes viral infection through cytoskeletal rearrangement mediated by CDC42 and RAC1 in human corneal epithelial cells. siRNA knockdown of Rap1b showed a dose-dependent decrease in viral infection levels, and Rap1b activation and membrane enrichment were observed from early stages of HSV-1 infection. PKA agonist Forskolin disturbed Rap1b activation and decreased viral infection in a dose-dependent manner.

biological.citation: Sonic hedgehog-heat shock protein 90β axis promotes the development of nonalcoholic steatohepatitis in mice. (PMID: 38342927)
biological.summary: miR-28-5p, enriched in exosomes secreted by hepatocytes under the SHH-HSP90β axis, directly targets and decreases Rap1b levels in macrophages, which in turn promotes NF-κB transcriptional activity and stimulates expression of inflammatory factors. Delivery of miR-28-5p to macrophages in mouse liver impaired NASH symptomatic development, and miR-28-5p was markedly elevated in NASH patient sera. This identifies Rap1b as a downstream effector in the SHH-HSP90β-miR-28-5p axis regulating hepatic inflammation.
biological.sample_size: NASH mouse model; NASH patient serum samples
